# Templates

Reusable documents for enterprise-oriented engineering work.

**Copyright © 2026 YankiDev ([yankidev.com](https://yankidev.com))**

## Scope

- Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
- Runbooks and incident templates
- Checklists for reviews, releases, and onboarding
- RFCs / design proposal skeletons
- Comparison and evaluation worksheets

## Available templates

| Template | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [Architecture Decision Record](architecture-decision-record.md) | Capture a significant technical decision |
| [Document skeleton](document-skeleton.md) | Standard structure for new Collection guides |
| [Tool evaluation checklist](tool-evaluation-checklist.md) | Evaluate tools against enterprise criteria |
| [Release readiness checklist](release-readiness-checklist.md) | Pre-release verification for teams |

## Usage

1. Copy a template into your workspace or fork.
2. Replace placeholders in `UPPER_SNAKE` or `{{braces}}` style.
3. Keep decisions and checklists versioned with your product docs.
